StatDef.label: shield block chance
StatDef.description:
Chance to attempt blocking an incoming attack with this shield.

If the attempt succeeds, a second armor roll (shield armor vs attacker AP) determines whether the attack is fully deflected.

Affected by melee skill, manipulation, and sight — identical modifiers to melee hit chance.

StatDef.label: shield deflect angle
StatDef.description: The total frontal arc (in degrees) within which this shield can deflect incoming attacks. For example, 90° means ±45° to each side.

StatDef.label: Shield Armor - Sharp
StatDef.description:
The protection this shield provides against sharp damage, such as bullets, knife stabs, explosions, and animal bites.
Unlike body armor, a shield either blocks an attack entirely or lets it through completely — there is no partial mitigation or blunt conversion.
When an attack lands within the shield's deflect arc and the block attempt succeeds, the shield's sharp armor rating is compared against the attacker's armor penetration:
threshold = max(Shield Armor - Attacker AP, 0)
A random roll from 0 to 1 is then made: - If the roll is below the threshold, the attack is fully blocked and deals no damage. - If the roll meets or exceeds the threshold, the attack fully penetrates — the shield has no effect.
For example, with 50% shield armor against an attack with 20% armor penetration, the threshold is 30%. There is a 30% chance of a full block, and a 70% chance of full penetration.
The shield's armor is applied only once, and only when a block attempt has already been triggered.
